quotes.author: Julian Calderin
quotes.text: My friends and I had an absolute blast wakesurfing/wakeboarding with these guys a couple of weeks ago. Well worth the money. Roland was an excellent instructor and had all of us up and shredding in no time at all. The boat was beautiful and these guys were even kind enough to make a pit stop mid-session to grab some cold snacks for the fellas. The boat operator resembled a young Patrick Swayze and he ran that boat perfectly. Couldn’t have asked for a better time.

quotes.author: Charlie Meberg
quotes.text: This was by far one of the best weeks of my summer the boat was amazing and the counselors were so nice. Ian and Roland were amazing and Brett was also pretty cool. They taught us so many things including wake surfing, wake boarding, and water skiing. We tubed a lot which was super fun and swam in the bay. I would 100% recommend this to anybody and I wish I was able to go again.

quotes.author: Tiffany Palagonia
quotes.text: My daughter recently attended Roland’s boating camp, she had an incredible experience! The instructors were knowledgeable and patient. I highly recommend.

quotes.author: Michele C-Misk
quotes.text: My daughter had so much fun! Everyone was very professional. Will definitely do it again.

quotes.author: Jenny Wu
quotes.text: We had sooo much fun!! Brett and Will were the best and made the experience amazing.
